status: RUN. Results are in MGCA-review-packet.md section 10 and in the harness output. The set has NOT been used to tune the matcher or to add variants to the case: section 10.6 is explicit that doing so and then quoting the result measures memorisation rather than coverage. It stays held out.
authoring_note: None of these phrasings appears in any variant list in the case file. Written in the registers section 10.6 says an author-written set tends to miss: clinical shorthand, typos, compound questions and conversational openers. The expected topic on each row is a drafting judgement and should be reviewed before any number is quoted.
out_of_scope_arm_note: Six out-of-scope questions is far too few to conclude anything. Section 10.6 puts the floor at thirty.
